pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which adjective is made from "Wind"? (1 mark)
   A. winden
   B. windig
   C. windich
   D. windlich

2. What does "der Sonntag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Wednesday
   C. week
   D. Sunday

3. Which question asks "Who is that?" (1 mark)
   A. Wer ist das?
   B. Was ist das?
   C. Wo ist das?
   D. Wie ist das?

4. Which two days make up the weekend (das Wochenende)? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag and Sonntag
   B. Montag and Dienstag
   C. Freitag and Samstag
   D. Sonntag and Montag

5. What number is "zwanzig"? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 13
   C. 20
   D. 9

6. What does "neblig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. dry
   C. foggy
   D. cloudy

7. What does "scharf" mean when we talk about a knife? (1 mark)
   A. heavy
   B. sharp
   C. cold
   D. small

8. What does "Bis bald" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thank you
   B. very good
   C. please
   D. see you soon

9. What does "auf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. in front of
   C. under
   D. on

10. Which German word means "always"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. oft
   C. gestern
   D. immer

11. Which is a safe way to send a greeting message? (1 mark)
   A. Write only to people you know
   B. Write to strangers
   C. Share passwords
   D. Send your address to anyone

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Bauch"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

13. What does "alt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tall or big
   B. old
   C. strong
   D. small

14. Which German word or phrase means "orange"? (1 mark)
   A. die Milch
   B. die Wassermelone
   C. die Orange
   D. das Wasser

15. What does "Dezember" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. August
   C. February
   D. December

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle. (2 marks)

17. Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür. (4 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present. (3 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot. (2 marks)

20. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth. (2 marks)

21. Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — windig
   Wind + -ig gives windig.

2. D — Sunday
   der Sonntag means Sunday.

3. A — Wer ist das?
   Wer means who.

4. A — Samstag and Sonntag
   The weekend is Saturday and Sunday.

5. C — 20
   zwanzig is the number 20.

6. C — foggy
   neblig means foggy.

7. B — sharp
   scharf means sharp.

8. D — see you soon
   Bis bald means see you soon.

9. D — on
   auf means on.

10. D — immer
   always in German is immer.

11. A — Write only to people you know
   We stay safe online by writing to people we know.

12. D — der
   It is der Bauch, so the little word is der.

13. B — old
   alt means old.

14. C — die Orange
   orange in German is die Orange.

15. D — December
   Dezember means December.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
